scores.notes: Peter stepping off the boat (left) and in the courtyard foreground (right): both middle-aged with dark curly hair greying at the temples, short grizzled beard, tanned skin and stocky build.
Daniel hauled from the pit (left) and pointing before the king (right): both an older lean man with short cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, same blue fringed robe and scroll case.
Holmes tossing the paper ball in the carriage (left) and lashing with the cane (right): both gaunt, clean-shaven, hawk-nosed with slicked-back dark hair and a high forehead, tall thin build.

Left Holmes (pulling the moustached man through the door) is a youthful man with tousled curly dark hair over the forehead and a fuller face; right Holmes in the armchair is an older gaunt man with slicked-back hair, widow's peak and hollow cheeks.

Peter diving from the boat (left, face seen in profile from above) and in the courtyard foreground (right): both have short dark curly hair, a short dark beard, tanned skin and stocky build; no conflicting cue, though the left face is small.

Moses striking the rock (left) and seated on the stone with arms held up (right): both an aged man with wavy white hair to the collar, full white beard, weathered tan skin and the same brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Peter standing at the bow with a net on his shoulder (left) and the front figure with the net by the fire (right): both middle-aged with short dark curly hair flecked grey, short greying beard, tan skin and sturdy build.
Peter grasping the lame man's hand (left) and stepping off the boat (right): both have short curly dark hair going grey, a short grizzled beard, tanned skin and a stocky build.
Daniel standing among the lions (left) and climbing out of the pit (right): both an older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and brown skin, same blue fringed robe and satchel.

Watson standing with arms crossed (left) is burly with a broad heavy-jowled ruddy face and a thick walrus moustache; Watson seated in the carriage (right) is slim with a narrow face and a small neat moustache. Hair colour matches but build and face shape conflict.

Both show a hillside of olive trees and pale stone houses sloping down to a lake with moored boats on the right, a white landmark building above the village and a dirt track by low stone walls; viewpoint differs (close by the house vs. on the road).

David kneeling by the brook (left) and kneeling under the oil horn (right): both a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and fair-tan skin in the same ragged brown tunic; right face is bowed but hair, age and build match.
Holmes with steepled fingers in the armchair (left) and raising the cane (right): both gaunt, clean-shaven, hollow-cheeked with slicked-back dark hair and a widow's peak, similar middle age.

Left den is an enclosed stone vault whose walls curve overhead to a small round opening with a barred grate; right den is a wide straight-sided cylinder fully open to the sky with a wooden lid and palms at the rim. Both are round block-built lion pits, but the roofed vault conflicts with the open-topped pit.
Holmes examining the hat with a lens (left) and striking at the bell-rope with a cane (right): both lean, clean-shaven, hawk-nosed with dark swept-back hair and a high forehead, similar middle age.

Both have a long tea table under a big tree with a house behind on the left, but the left house is pale stone/stucco with plain windows and the table has a white cloth, while the right house is red brick and timber with leaded lattice windows and a tiled porch and the table is bare wood.

Both show a single-masted wooden fishing boat with a hanging lantern on a dark heaving sea under a moon half-hidden by storm cloud, with a low hilly shoreline in the distance; right is just a closer view of the stern.

Daniel pointing in the hall (left) and standing roped in the pit (right, small but face visible): both an older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, same blue fringed mantle and scroll case.

Jesus calling at the tomb (left) and standing in the boat with arm out (right): both have shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short full dark beard, similar age and slim build, same white tunic and blue-grey mantle.

Peter with net and staff clasping the lame man's hand (left) and the front man with staff and net by the fire (right): both have short curly dark hair greying, a short grizzled beard, tan skin and sturdy build.

Holmes seated with pipe and photograph (left) and holding the lens over the hat (right): both gaunt, clean-shaven, sharp-nosed with slicked-back dark hair and receding temples, similar age and thin build.

Moses seated with arms held up (left) and raising the staff at the rock (right): both an aged man with white hair, long full white beard, weathered tan skin and the same pale tunic with dark brown cloak.

Alice before the mushroom (left, small, in profile) and holding the bottle (right): both a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and slight build, same yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Moses seated between the two helpers (left) and standing with staff before the parting sea (right, in profile from behind): both an old man with collar-length white hair and a full white beard, same brown cloak over pale tunic.

Moses stretching his hand over the sea (left, profile) and walking with staff at right foreground of the crossing (right): both an old man with wind-blown white hair, long white beard, tan weathered skin and brown cloak over a pale tunic.

Watson seated holding the hat brim (left) and in a bowler in the carriage (right): both a sturdy middle-aged man with brown hair, a full brown moustache, square ruddy face and similar build; the bowler hides some hair but nothing conflicts.
Holmes stooping with his cane on the pavement (left) and holding the lens (right): both gaunt, clean-shaven, sharp-nosed with slicked-back dark hair and receding temples, tall thin build.
Watson in a bowler in the carriage (left) and seated by the fire (right): both a solid middle-aged man with brown hair, a thick brown moustache, squarish ruddy face and medium-sturdy build.
Peter stepping from the boat (left) and pulling up the lame man with staff in hand (right): both have short dark curly hair with grey, a short greying beard, tan skin and a stocky build.

David dodging the spear (left) and kneeling at the brook (right): both a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and fair-tan skin in a plain brown tunic; left reads slightly younger but no cue conflicts.

Daniel watching the fiery thrones (left) and standing roped in the pit (right, small): both an older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, same dark blue fringed mantle over a pale tunic.

Holmes with pipe outside the shopfront (left, small) and raising the cane with a lit match (right): both gaunt, clean-shaven, hollow-cheeked with slicked-back dark hair and widow's peak, tall thin build.

Peter with hand on chest at far left of the courtyard (left, small) and leaping from the boat (right): both middle-aged with short curly hair, short greying beard, tan skin and stocky build; right hair is greyer in the sunlight but still salt-and-pepper curls, not a clear conflict.

Watson in a bowler beside Holmes on the pavement (left) and seated on the bed (right): both a sturdy middle-aged man with a brown moustache, squarish face and brown hair where visible; hat hides most hair on the left.

Daniel climbing out of the pit (left) and gesturing at the wall writing (right): both an older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and brown skin, same blue fringed robe and shoulder satchel.

Holmes stooping with cane on the pavement (left) and reaching up with the cane by the bed (right): both gaunt, clean-shaven, hollow-cheeked with slicked-back dark hair and high forehead, tall thin build.

Moses with arms spread before the parted sea (left, in profile from behind) and seated with raised arms (right): both an old man with collar-length white hair and a full white beard, pale tunic and dark brown cloak.

Holmes with pipe in the armchair (left) and tapping the pavement with his cane in a hat (right, small): both thin, clean-shaven with a long gaunt sharp-nosed face and dark hair; the hat hides the hairline on the right but nothing conflicts.

David after the sling throw (left, small) and kneeling under the oil horn (right, head bowed): both a slim clean-shaven teenage boy with short dark curly hair and tan skin in a short brown tunic; faces are small/bowed but hair, age and build agree with no conflict.

Both show a long cloth-covered tea table on a lawn beneath a huge spreading tree with the trunk right of centre and a pale stone two-storey house behind on the left, same chairs and china; the left house has more gables but nothing clearly conflicts.

David kneeling to be anointed (left) and dodging the spear with the harp (right): both a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and fair-tan skin in the same brown tunic with satchel.

Alice before the mushroom (left, small, profile) and holding the flamingo (right): both a young girl with long light-brown hair held by a band, fair skin and slight build, same yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Peter with net and staff lifting the lame man (left) and front figure with net by the fire (right): both middle-aged with short curly dark hair greying, a short grizzled beard and sturdy build; left hair is a little greyer and skin a little lighter, but not a clear conflict.

Alice in the wing chair at the tea table (left) and holding the flamingo (right): both a girl of about eight with long straight light-brown hair, fair round face and slight build, same yellow dress, pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Both show a wet, rock-strewn sandy seabed corridor running into a dark green storm sea under heavy cloud with light breaking at the horizon; left is seen from inside the corridor with full water walls, right from the rocky shore as the parting begins, which the descriptions account for.

Both have a cloth-covered tea table under a big tree with a cottage behind on the right, but the left house is pale stone with a shingle/slate roof, dormers and a brick chimney, while the right is a thatched half-timbered cottage smothered in climbing roses: different architecture.

Moses raising the staff at the rock (left) and with arms spread before the sea (right, profile from behind): both an old man with thinning white hair to the collar and a long white beard, same pale tunic and dark brown cloak.

Jesus calling at the tomb (left) and on the cross at upper right (right, small, top cropped): both a lean man with shoulder-length dark hair and a short dark beard, similar age and skin tone; clothing differs by scene only.

Jesus on the centre cross (left, small) and walking on the water (right): both a lean man with long dark brown hair to the shoulders and a short dark beard, similar skin tone; the left face is small but no cue conflicts.

Jesus on the water (left) and calling with raised arm at the tomb (right): both have long dark brown centre-parted hair, a short full dark beard, same age and slim build, same white tunic with blue-grey mantle.

Moses stretching his hand toward the sea (left) and with staff pointing at the pig (right): both an old man with long white hair, a full white beard, weathered tan skin and a brown cloak over a pale tunic.
Holmes gripping the moustached man's arm at the door (left) and lashing with the cane (right): both tall, gaunt and clean-shaven with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead and hooked nose.

Peter standing with a net at left of the courtyard (left) and standing on the bow (right): both middle-aged with short dark curly hair, short greying beard, tan-brown skin and sturdy build; right hair shows a bit more grey but no clear conflict.

Peter standing with a net at left of the courtyard (left) and with net and staff lifting the lame man (right): both middle-aged with short dark curly hair, short greying beard, tan-brown skin and sturdy build; right is a little greyer, not a clear conflict.

David after the sling throw (left) and kneeling at the brook with stones (right): both a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark wavy-curly hair and fair-tan skin in the same brown tunic with satchel.
Both show the same single-masted wooden boat with a torn pale sail on a grey choppy lake under heavy overcast, with green-brown hills along the far shore; right is a closer view toward the stern.

Both show a calm pale-blue lake with a pebbly shore, a small smoking fire at the water's edge, a wooden fishing boat just offshore and low hills with cypresses under a clear daytime sky; the stone hut on the right would sit behind the left viewpoint, so nothing conflicts.
Holmes gripping the moustached man's arm at the door (left) and holding the lens over the hat (right): both tall, gaunt and clean-shaven with slicked-back dark hair, high forehead and hooked nose.

Watson at the door with hat and bag (left) and seated by the fire (right): both a middle-aged man with side-parted brown hair, a brown moustache, squarish face and solid build; right is seen closer and ruddier but no cue conflicts.
